1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.NonvertexRouteStability
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SourceNeighborhood
3 
4 /-! The multiple-route set, augmented by original vertices other than the
5 source, is compact. Finite embedded-tree structure is a separate obligation. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- Multiple-route targets together with all original vertices other than the source. -/
12 def cutSet (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : Set (frontier P.body) :=
13   {b | (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a ∨ ((b : Space) ∈ P.vertices ∧ b ≠ a)}
14 
15 theorem source_not_cutSet (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : a ∉ P.cutSet a := by
16   rintro (multiple | vertex)
17   · exact ((P.multiple_routes_iff_fiber a a).mp multiple).1 rfl
18   · exact vertex.2 rfl
19 
20 namespace SixVertexGraph
21 
22 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
23   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
24     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
25 
26 include graph small_faces in
27 /-- In canonical models, all limits of multiple-route points lie in the explicit cut set. -/
28 theorem closure_multiple_subset_cutSet (a : frontier P.body) :
29     closure {b : frontier P.body | (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a} ⊆ P.cutSet a := by
30   intro b limit
31   have different : a ≠ b := by
32     rintro rfl
33     exact P.source_not_closure_multiple_routes a limit
34   by_cases vertex : (b : Space) ∈ P.vertices
35   · exact Or.inr ⟨vertex, different.symm⟩
36   · exact Or.inl (graph.multiple_routes_closed_nonvertex small_faces a b different vertex limit)
37 
38 include graph small_faces in
39 /-- Adding precisely the original vertices other than the source makes the multiple-route set closed. -/
40 theorem cutSet_closed (a : frontier P.body) : IsClosed (P.cutSet a) := by
41   let vertices : Set (frontier P.body) := {b | (b : Space) ∈ P.vertices ∧ b ≠ a}
42   have finite : vertices.Finite :=
43     (P.vertices.finite_toSet.preimage (f := fun b : frontier P.body => (b : Space)) Subtype.val_injective.injOn).subset
44       (fun _ h => h.1)
45   apply isClosed_of_closure_subset
46   change closure ({b : frontier P.body | (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a} ∪ vertices) ⊆ P.cutSet a
47   rw [closure_union, finite.isClosed.closure_eq]
48   exact union_subset (graph.closure_multiple_subset_cutSet small_faces a) (fun _ member => Or.inr member)
49 
50 include graph small_faces in
51 /-- The explicit cut set is a compact subset of the actual boundary. -/
52 theorem cutSet_compact (a : frontier P.body) : IsCompact (P.cutSet a) := by
53   letI : CompactSpace (frontier P.body) := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp
54     (P.body_compact.of_isClosed_subset isClosed_frontier P.body_closed.frontier_subset)
55   exact (graph.cutSet_closed small_faces a).isCompact
56 
57 end SixVertexGraph
58 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
